data.name: Description
data.value: Before a sensitive or critical action, Jarvis asks for your agreement: a window opens, and after a spoken request he asks the question aloud. Without an answer, the action is denied.

data.name: TimeoutHint
data.value: From {0} to {1} seconds. After it, the action is denied.

data.name: WordsHint
data.value: Your whole answer must be one of these. Anything else is a refusal. A critical action is approved with a click only.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The setting could not be saved.
